commands_used: answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. The knight-captain disc led me to Vicrium, an old mine, where the knights kept a strongbox. It is a trail to the Eye of Argonia, a jewel that can heal trees, at the Root. The order wants it before the Unbound. 2. Get into the lower galleries and search the knights strongbox. 3. Get the key from Ah-Zish by talking, paying 100 gold, or stealing it (lockpick or pickpocket); or take the old lower adit through crocodile water; smugglers are inside, so fight or sneak. 4. I do not know what the Root and the Eye really are, why the Unbound seal trees, or how Nesh-Deeka knows things. I could find out by exploring and asking people.
pick Door to Lower Galleries win

answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka. Following the knight-captain disc I reached Vicrium, used the old adit (Ah-Zish key never actually reached me), and took a parchment map from the knights strongbox: seven towers in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island. It is part of the trail to the Eye of Argonia and the Root, which the order wants before the Unbound. 2. Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Go to Helstrom directly; I could also look at the map myself first, or deal with the smuggler here, but nothing requires it. 4. I do not know where the seven towers or tooth crag are, what the Root and Eye truly are, how Nesh-Deeka knows so much, or why the Unbound seal trees. Nesh-Deeka or the map may tell me.

answer 1. I gave Nesh-Deeka the map. She says it is another step to the Eye of Argonia, and her officer will read the towers and tooth crag. She knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium, saying only "we listen". She made me Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, and paid 200 gold. 2. Choose the order gift from Nesh-Deeka, a rapier or a quarterstaff. 3. Take the rapier or the quarterstaff. I favour the rapier as a light blade for a sneaky key-type character. 4. I still do not know how she listens, who her officer is, what the Root and Eye truly are, or why the Unbound seal trees.

answer 1. I took the rapier. Nesh-Deeka now has me report to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, in the same room. 2. Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice here in Nesh-Deeka house. 3. Just talk to her; no other route visible. 4. I still do not know what the seven towers and tooth crag mean, how the order listens, or what the Root, Eye and tree-sealing really are. Never-Writes-Twice may explain the map.

answer 1. The map shows the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha. Never-Writes-Twice marked it. She warned me about Cuts-the-Old-Knot, once of the order, mad on sap, who killed her minders; I should not listen to her. The Vicrium quest is done. 2. Nothing is set; presumably Skeith Isle next, by boat via Archon and Arorha. 3. Go toward Skeith Isle, or first pursue the Unbound or the Collector Ennodius Vanin. 4. Unknown: what the seven towers mean, where Cuts-the-Old-Knot is, what the Root and Eye are, how the order listens, why the Unbound seal trees.

answer Notes: Vicrium quest done. Ah-Zish key never reached me (persuasion and 100 gold both said yes, but no key or gold change), so I used the Old Lower Adit and took an old parchment map from the knights strongbox: seven towers in the sea and a tooth crag. I gave it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. She knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium ("we listen"), made me Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker (second rank), paid 200 gold and gave me Toh-Wos Rapier. I now report to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, who identified the crag as the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha, and marked it. She warned me off Cuts-the-Old-Knot, once of the order, mad on sap, killed her minders. I carry: rapier, 2 lockpicks, Grey Seal paralysis poison x3, Pale Harvest key, Eye-Setting, keystone, Unbound-Note, Voh-Vastei armour, grave-stake, bronze disc, about 950 gold. Still unknown: what the Root and the Eye really are, how the order listens, why the Unbound seal trees, the seven towers. Next: Skeith Isle via Archon and Arorha, the Unbound, and the Collector Ennodius Vanin.
